title: Ericsson Australia Pty Limited - proposed acquisition of Marconi Australia Pty Limited

body_sections.Summary: Ericsson Australia Pty Ltd proposed acquisition of Marconi Australia Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: Given the small overlap between the parties' Australian businesses, the ACCC did not consider it necessary to comprehensively define the relevant markets.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any relevant market due to a small degree of overlap of the parties' Australian businesses and the number of competing suppliers that would remain.
